mapper.sql: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.status, u.frozen_reason, u.created_at, u.last_login_at, p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name, p.birth_date, p.nationality, COALESCE(k.status, 'NONE') AS kyc_status, k.doc_type, k.doc_number, k.reviewed_at AS kyc_reviewed_at, k.reject_reason AS kyc_reject_reason FROM account_user u LEFT JOIN account_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN account_kyc_application k ON k.id = (SELECT MAX(k2.id) FROM account_kyc_application k2 WHERE k2.user_id = u.id)

where.if: AND (u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CONCAT_WS(' ', p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.id = #{id})

mapper.select: ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_user u LEFT JOIN account_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN account_kyc_application k ON k.id = (SELECT MAX(k2.id) FROM account_kyc_application k2 WHERE k2.user_id = u.id)
SELECT ip, created_at FROM account_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_profile (user_id, first_name, middle_name, last_name, birth_date, nationality) VALUES (#{userId}, #{firstName}, #{middleName}, #{lastName}, #{birthDate}, #{nationality}) AS n ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE first_name = n.first_name, middle_name = n.middle_name, last_name = n.last_name, birth_date = n.birth_date, nationality = n.nationality
mapper.update: UPDATE account_user SET frozen_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT k.id, k.user_id, u.email, p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name, p.nationality, p.birth_date, k.doc_type, k.doc_number, k.front_key, k.back_key, k.selfie_key, k.status, k.submitted_at, k.reviewer_id, k.reviewed_at, k.reject_reason FROM account_kyc_application k JOIN account_user u ON u.id = k.user_id LEFT JOIN account_profile p ON p.user_id = k.user_id

where.if: AND (u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CONCAT_WS(' ', p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR k.user_id = #{id} OR k.id = #{id})

mapper.select: ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_kyc_application k JOIN account_user u ON u.id = k.user_id LEFT JOIN account_profile p ON p.user_id = k.user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_kyc_application WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_user WHERE created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM account_session WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at >= #{since}
